exact_semantic_question: What does NODI code C mean for a FY2025 DMR row with no numeric result?
relation_contract: no_numeric_result_case.nodi_code must be interpreted before missing-evidence classification

candidate_interpretations.label: documented_no_discharge_period
candidate_interpretations.description: NODI C indicates the permittee reported that no discharge occurred for the monitoring period, excusing numeric pollutant/flow values.

candidate_interpretations.label: conditional_monitoring_not_required
candidate_interpretations.description: NODI C indicates monitoring was not required because the conditional limit set (storm-runoff discharge) did not apply for the period.

candidate_interpretations.label: other_documented_no_data_state
candidate_interpretations.description: NODI C indicates some other EPA/ICIS-standard no-data reason distinct from missing required evidence.

candidate_interpretations.label: missing_required_monitoring_evidence
candidate_interpretations.description: NODI C is merely a placeholder for absent numeric reporting while monitoring remained required (OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG=N).

retained_snippets.why_retained: Shows the blocked case pattern: FY2025 period, no numeric result, NODI C on the representative occurrence cited in OBLIGATION.md.

retained_snippets.location: aggregate query over all rows with NODI_CODE=C and empty DMR_VALUE_NMBR
retained_snippets.text: 150 rows; all EXTERNAL_PERMIT_NMBR=NM0000116; all FY2025 monitoring periods; no other NODI codes share this C+empty-value pattern besides separate NODI 9 rows on NM0020583
retained_snippets.why_retained: Establishes that resolving NODI C is a single code-level question concentrated on one permit's storm-runoff limit set.

retained_snippets.text: EXTERNAL_PERMIT_NMBR=NM0000116, LIMIT_SET_NAME=DISCHARGE STORM RUNOFFS FROM STORAGE, PARAMETER_DESC=Flow in conduit or thru treatment plant, OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG=N, LIMIT_FREQ_OF_ANALYSIS_CODE=01/01
retained_snippets.why_retained: Links NODI C rows to a non-optional storm-runoff limit set whose applicability depends on discharge occurrence.

retained_snippets.location: Part II.B Authorized Discharges; Part II.C items 2-4; lines 182-203
retained_snippets.text: Discharges are restricted to overflows from the retention pond due to catastrophic or chronic precipitation events. ... If a discharge of storm runoff from a quarry (mining) area is necessary, the discharge must comply with effluent limitations established at Outfall 001.
retained_snippets.why_retained: Permit narrative for NM0000116 describes conditional storm-runoff discharge but does not define NODI C or DMR no-data codes.

retained_snippets.text: As previously described the permittee has not discharged in over five years and is unable to obtain a sample to analyze at the appropriate detection level.
retained_snippets.why_retained: Background that NM0000116 facility discharge is infrequent; does not map NODI C to no-discharge reporting.

retained_snippets.location: Part I.B Reporting of Monitoring Results; lines 103-115
retained_snippets.text: Discharge Monitoring Report (DMR) results shall be electronically reported to EPA per 40 CFR 127.16. ... Monitoring information shall be submitted quarterly.
retained_snippets.why_retained: NM0000116 DMR reporting instructions contain no NODI code legend and no NO DISCHARGE code-C instruction.

retained_snippets.location: Part I item 5 NO DISCHARGE REPORTING; lines 150-153
retained_snippets.text: If there is no discharge from any outfall during the sampling month, place an "X" in the NO DISCHARGE box located in the upper right corner of the Discharge Monitoring Report.
retained_snippets.why_retained: Shows an alternate no-discharge reporting mechanism (checkbox) in a different permit; does not mention NODI code C and is not NM0000116's permit text.

retained_snippets.text: structured CSVs + document inventory; no codebook table in structured sources
retained_snippets.why_retained: Confirms absence of structured NODI legend; workspace-wide grep found no NODI definitional text in documents/.

contradictory_evidence.summary: Permit NM0028762 instructs no-discharge reporting via a DMR checkbox, not via NODI code C; NM0000116 permit text lacks even that instruction.
contradictory_evidence.implication: No-discharge reporting semantics in workspace documents cannot be equated to NODI C without an unstated external codebook.

contradictory_evidence.summary: All NODI C rows have OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG=N on linked limits, arguing against a simple 'monitoring not required' reading from structured flags alone.
contradictory_evidence.implication: Structural fields do not uniquely select among candidate interpretations.

known_limitations: No NODI code definition or legend appears anywhere in sources/ or documents/; only the CSV field NODI_CODE carries the value C.
All 150 occurrences are on permit NM0000116; permit-package text for that permit does not define ICIS NODI codes.
Structural correlation with storm-runoff limits and empty numeric fields is not a code legend per workspace rules.
External EPA ICIS/NODI documentation is out of scope and was not used.
